content.trans: 正确，同居就是没有性生活。我小时候听老师说，安全性行为就是不发生性关系。

content.text: Because there's always a little bit of danger.
content.trans: 因为总是有一点危险。

content.text: This is something that I think they tell a lot of young people to scare them but there is some truth to it.
content.trans: 这是他们经常告诉年轻人的东西，但其实有一些道理。

content.text: Yes of course. Now what do you think about this topic? Do you think it's worthwhile and we should teach children sexual education or many people protest against it and say this is wrong.
content.trans: 是的，你说得对。现在你认为这个话题值得讨论吗？你觉得它值得教育儿童，还是很多人反对它，并且说这是不对的。

content.text: We shouldn't be giving kids condoms when they're in high school.
content.trans: 我们不应该在高中给孩子们提供避孕套。

content.text: I think that kids in most parts of the world will have sex whether or not you tell them not to.
content.trans: 我认为世界上大多数地方的孩子，即使你不阻止他们，也会发生性行为。

content.text: Because of that, because everyone is going to be people trying it, I think it's important to inform students and inform kids who are in high school of options and of safety and of important health measures.
content.trans: 因为那样，因为大家都被要求参加，我认为对学生们和高中生来说非常重要的是要告知他们选项、安全措施以及重要的健康措施。

content.text: Otherwise you risk unwanted pregnancies and you risk people getting these serious diseases like AIDS.
content.trans: 否则，你可能会意外怀孕，并且你还可能让这些严重疾病如艾滋病传播。

content.text: That's right I think it is a very important topic. Some countries or some places even within the United States are a little bit more conservative than others.
content.trans: 英语：那你说得对，我认为这是一个非常重要的话题。一些国家或美国的一些地方甚至比其他国家更保守。

content.text: Many times they are against this type of education but I've actually encountered people who never received sexual education and well until they were maybe like 18.
content.trans: 很多人都反对这种教育，但我真的遇到了一些人，他们从没有接受过性教育，甚至到了大概18岁才开始。

content.text: They thought they can get pregnant by a kiss.
content.trans: 他们以为可以通过一个吻怀孕。

content.text: So I think that's one of the dangers. Obviously there are both sides to this issue and we're curious to know what you think.
content.trans: 所以我觉得这就是一个危险。当然，这个问题的两面都有，我们也很想知道你的看法。

content.text: Do you think that sex ed should be a course or should be something that people talk about in schools in high school or in college?
content.trans: 你觉得性教育应该是一门课程，还是应该在学校高中或大学里讨论呢？

content.text: Do they do this in your home country? Let us know or our website is englisepad.com.
content.trans: 他们在那里这样做吗？告诉我们吧，或者我们的网站是englisepad.com。

content.text: Alright we'll see you guys there. Bye.
content.trans: 好的，我们到时候见。再见。
